Thanks for the ping — answered inline and added concrete phrasing to use on invoices. TL;DR: we can accept a single combined invoice but need explicit line-level tax markers and supporting docs.

Requirements (AP / PO matching):
- Line-level tax treatment: each invoice line must include a short code in the description indicating tax treatment: [RC-EU] for reverse-charge EU/UK lines, [MX-CFDI] for Mexican subcontractor lines. Example: "Implementation services — 40 hrs — [RC-EU]".
- VAT registration proof: copy of VAT registration (VAT-GB-Registration-GB12345678.pdf) must be attached to the onboarding package. We store it in the supplier record; not required on every invoice thereafter, but we may request it during first payment.
- Reverse-charge wording: for UK/EU-origin services, include this exact line on the invoice footer: "VAT reverse charge applies — recipient to account for VAT under Article 194 (or UK equivalent)." Small variants OK but please keep the phrase 'reverse charge' and cite the registration number.
- Mixed invoices: allowed, provided each line carries the tax code and the invoice includes a single combined total and clearly separated tax subtotal lines. Our AP system will accept a mixed invoice if the XML or PDF has: (a) line descriptions with codes, (b) an attached CFDI XML for MX lines, and (c) a separate subtotal section showing EU/UK taxable base (0 VAT / reverse-charge) and MX taxable base (local tax applied or zero, per CFDI).
- PO mapping: the PO must reference the supplier legal entity that issued the invoice. If SoftOps issues a single invoice that embeds Mercadeo lines, the PO should be against SoftOps' vendor record and include an internal note: "contains MX subcontractor lines — see CFDI attached". If Mercadeo needs to be a separate payee for the MX portion, we may require two invoices tied to the same PO number.

Next steps for onboarding:
1) Elena — attach VAT registration (PDF) to the supplier record.
2) If you plan to continue mixing MX subcontractor lines, indicate whether Mercadeo should be set up as a second vendor (preferred) or if SoftOps will route the MX payable through their ledger.
3) Provide one sample combined invoice in PDF+XML so AP can validate automated parsing.

I'll review the sample files once uploaded and confirm final acceptance criteria. Vivek — can you confirm whether procurement wants Mercadeo set up as a second vendor or expect SoftOps to be sole vendor?

Thanks,
